newsitem.title: UK: J.P.Morgan committed to base metals - official.
newsitem.headline: J.P.Morgan committed to base metals - official.

text.p: J.P.Morgan is "totally committed to all aspects of the base and precious metals business", said Joe Evangelisti head of European public relations for the U.S. bank.
Evangelisti was responding to questions following rumours amongst some base metal traders that J.P.Morgan might wholly or partially withdraw from trading base metals.
"No way" is the bank pulling out of base metals, Evangelisti said.
J.P.Morgan is a major player on the London Metal Exchange (LME) where it is an associate clearing broker member but not a ring dealing member of the exchange.
Along with other major U.S. banks J.P.Morgan is prominent in the base metals options business where much of the activity is conducted in Over-the-Counter (OTC) contracts.
J.P.Morgan is also an active member of the London bullion market. Traders said there has been no talk of it reducing its presence in precious metals.
